🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 1, 2026

Moon, in Gemini, holds a sextile to Saturn, in its fall in Aries. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon in Gemini makes room for you, and then waits. Fire moves first here, and first is enough. Since Mars crossed out of Cancer, the question has changed.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Mercury in Scorpio sits opposite: your figure meets somebody else’s. Earth keeps its grip past the point it is worth. Unchanged for three weeks: you know what it asks.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. Moon crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Air changes shape until there is only one shape. Four weeks of Virgo ended, and nothing carried over.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from Gemini, untitled. Mercury in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal water opens the account without argument. A week ago Moon was still held by Venus; that is finished.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you from Libra, where it stands lowest. From Gemini, Moon hands you an opening. Fire that holds on, holding without strain. Four weeks ago Sun was still in Virgo: the ground has moved.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon squares you from Gemini, and the cost objects. Mutable earth: every option kept is an option paid for. The sextile to Jupiter that held a week ago has let go.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. From Gemini, Moon concedes the point early. Air begins, and beginning asks little today. Venus left Libra four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. Venus is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Water holds on until the thing and the self are one. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, holds no rank in Leo and simply works. From Gemini, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Mutable fire keeps two accounts open and pays both. The sextile of a week ago is off it now.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. From Libra, Sun sets a figure against the wanting. Cardinal earth starts and is invoiced for it. Jupiter let go of it a week ago.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Moon in Gemini trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Air keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you from Leo on plain terms, without privilege. From Gemini, Moon cuts across the appetite. Water adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. This is days old, not weeks, and behaves like it.
